name: WD-40 Multi-Use Industrial Maintenance Spray with Smart Straw (420ml)
shortDescription: The world's leading 5-in-1 maintenance chemical: stops squeaks, displaces moisture, cleans residues, loosens rusted parts, and protects against corrosion.
overview: WD-40 Multi-Use Product is the world's most versatile chemical maintenance tool, renowned for five core superpowers: displacing moisture, penetrating rusted bonds, lubricating moving assemblies, cleaning grease/grime, and preventing corrosion. Equipped with the innovative permanently attached Smart Straw, users can spray two ways: flip up for precision jet application into tiny crevices and pinholes, or flip down for wide-angle fan coverage across large metal surfaces. Its dielectric formulation makes it safe on electrical contacts and switchgear.
keyFeatures: 5-in-1 Action: Stops squeaks, drives out moisture, cleans, loosens rust, and frees sticky parts
Permanently attached Smart Straw sprays in precision stream or wide fan spray
Super-penetrating capillary action frees seized, corroded bolts, nuts, and linkages
Displaces moisture instantly from wet electrical ignitions, switches, and electric motors
Deposits a micro-thin anti-corrosion barrier that shields metal from atmospheric moisture
Dissolves stubborn adhesive residue, road tar, gunk, tape glue, and heavy grime
Dielectric breakdown voltage exceeding 35 kV: safe for electrical switchgear

specifications.Dispenser Type: Dual-Action Smart Straw (Pinpoint Jet / Wide Fan Spray)

applications: Freeing severely seized, rusted, and galled bolts, studs, and threaded pipe fittings
Drying out drowned electrical circuit boards, alternators, spark plugs, and junction boxes
Lubricating conveyor chains, bearings, locks, sliding drawer tracks, and pneumatic valves
Protecting precision ground machine tool ways, chucks, and micrometers against flash rust
